user_query: I'm planning a trip to Barcelona with my friends next month. Can you provide me with a list of webcams in Barcelona to check the current weather and view the popular tourist spots? Also, suggest some nearby cities to explore during our trip.

TaskList.description: Retrieve a list of webcams located in Barcelona that provide live feeds for weather and tourist spots.
Gather information on popular tourist spots in Barcelona that can be viewed through the retrieved webcams.
Identify nearby cities that are worth exploring during the trip to Barcelona.
